_comment: 1 mHz triangle for a 20-minute ECM sweep. RAMP shape; for a ramp the duty_cycle is the rise SYMMETRY - 50 = a symmetric triangle (rises half the period, falls half), 100 = rising sawtooth, 0 = falling sawtooth. frequency 0.001 Hz -> period 1000 s (16.7 min), so a 20-minute run covers ~1.2 cycles. 4 Vpp on a 2.5 V offset -> a 0.5..4.5 V automotive-style sweep. INFinity load matches a high-impedance ECM input / 1 MOhm scope. Output stays OFF until output_on.
name: triangle_1mhz
